title: Bullets start inside the shooter, on paths through the muzzle
intent: Let point-blank shots hit an enemy pressed against the player without changing any gun's spread or reach

attempts.failureReason: an enemy between the player and the barrel was skipped; every weapon did 0 damage at 0-8 px, the rifle also at 20 px

attempts.approach: spawn every pellet at the centre along its own angle
attempts.failureReason: the shotgun fan then opened 26 px further back, so at 90 px an outer pellet missed an Elite (40 damage instead of 48)

evidence.description: point blank at 0, 10 and 20 px - pistol 10, shotgun 48, rifle 9
shotgun lands all 6 pellets (48) on an Elite at 90 px

constraints.statement: Fire with (x, y) at the shooter's centre and lead = distance to the muzzle; Weapon.tryFire starts each bullet lead px back along its own path from the muzzle and adds lead to its lifetime
Every bullet path passes through the muzzle, so a fan (the shotgun) opens at the barrel and reach past the muzzle stays the gun's range
